post.description:
Repeated slugs collapse to one. If any slug matches no link on the key's team the request is
refused with 404 and `errors.slugs` lists every such slug. If the acting user may not manage
any one named link it is refused with 403. `move` requires `folder_id` (null unfiles); `tag`
adds tags without removing existing ones and refuses with 422 if any link would exceed 5
tags. In every refusal nothing changes.

name.description: A stable, machine-readable error identifier. One of: validation_error, unauthorized, forbidden, missing_user_agent, unsupported_version, not_found, rate_limited, server_error, team_suspended, bad_request.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated in the response body for callers that only inspect the payload.

errors.description: Field-level validation messages when `name` is `validation_error`; on `POST /links/bulk`'s `not_found`, `errors.slugs` lists the slugs that matched no link.

BulkLinkRequest.description:
Validates the shape of a bulk move / tag / delete request addressed by slug.

Link ownership is not a shape concern: it is enforced downstream by
LinkPolicy in the controller. The folder is the one team-scoped lookup done
here, so a foreign folder id fails exactly like an unknown one.
BulkLinkRequest.title: BulkLinkRequest

LinkStatus.description: A link's lifecycle state, derived worst-first by Link::status(). These values are a published API contract once the links API ships them: adding a case is additive, renaming or removing one is breaking.
LinkStatus.title: LinkStatus

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
